reviews.text: Very efficient and organized. Everyone was nice, professional, and treated my dog like their own. They even removed my dogs dewclaws for a reasonable price.
Good experience with low cost cat and dog sterilization! Caring staff and affordable.
We had our 1 year old puppy spayed here on Friday. They are quick, professional and very knowledgeable. I highly recommend this place. They also have fantastic prices!

I took my dog here to get spayed and shockingly the price turned out to be cheaper than what was on their website, which was great, but most of all they took very good care of my dog very quickly and made sure I was sent home with all the information I needed. I also called them and messaged them multiple times and they thankfully dealt with it were sweet about it and knew that I was just a worried pet owner.
Very friendly and very quick. No long drawn out wait times or long visits.
Friendly staff and great prices!
Got our Kitten Spayed. Did an excellent job!

Friendly front desk, quick, efficient service. Had 2 6 month old kittens spayed. They did very well. Communication from scheduling, appt. reminder, appt., pre-op prep, all the way through to pick-up and post-op care was top notch.
Great service, great communication, great results, reasonable cost

I have taken two of my pets here one dog one cat and they have done absolutely amazing always heal properly. Never any issues and I love their prices. It’s a great place to take your pet when it’s time to spay and neuter.

I took my 2 year old DLH black cat, tomato to SNiP for a neutering procedure for only $79. Snip does more than spay/neuter for cats and dogs. They offer many other pet services!

They were very helpful, and sent several appointment reminder emails to get you ready for your appointment. They are very clear on instructions for your appointment, how to prepare, and how to care for your pet after the procedure. They also send a visit summary email containing a PDF while your pet is finishing up, with an email you can epay your invoice online before pickup so all I had to do was walk in and tell them which pet I was there for.

They were very professional and kind to me and tomato, given he's a little skittish they were very gentle with him. They informed me and answered any questions I had. I was very happy with my service and would bring him back for other services.

Good place to get your cat spayed and neutered but beware of purchasing the 'cone' for your female animal. They charge you $18 for a cheap plastic cone with gauze! Purchase your own since you will get a better option.

I took my kitten Moxi in to get neutered and had a wonderful experience with this place. From start to finish the communication was clear and informative. The ease of drop off and pick up was a breeze. I love the text chat that was available for anything I needed. And, when they say low cost, they absolutely mean it! Being on a fixed income this is important to me. I would absolutely use them again if needed. I highly recommend this facility for your pet care needs. 10/10 for sure.

The girl at the front desk was awful and rude!!!!!

My review is not based on the delay from needing medical records. I understand that and should have provided those. It was at check in prior- extremely unsettling to drop off a pet you love with someone so dismissively rude and unpersonable. When I picked up my cat they told me he would be out of sorts from the drugs they gave him but I have 3 other cats and have never had a cat that messed up on drugs. He couldn't walk straight until the next day  and was acting so odd it was so sad. He also STILL HAS HIS BALLS 😂 wth. My other male doesn't after neutering and my parents cats didnt after neutering. Maybe its a new procedure?
So happy they are here. It takes so much stress off of an already stressful situation.
Got my cat spayed today they were so good and friendly 🩷 would definitely recommend my friends

They were phenomenal! I previously took my two other puppies to the Spay & Neuter Clinic and it was like a cattle call, having to wait over an hour each time just to be seen. Plus, the location of that clinic in Glendale was super disgusting outside, with used condoms and needles littering the sidewalk both times I went.I wish I had known about the Snip clinic before! I was so thankful to use it on my third puppy. It took two minutes to get in and one minute to get out. And they were even $60 cheaper! They were amazing!
Went back withy two male doggies today.  I love how professional and fantastic they are
The whole staff was amazing, and our cats didn't even know what happened
They were great at taking care of both of my girls! Great & friendly service. Highly recommend!

This clinic is awesome! We had our puppy neutered today and everyone at this clinic are the best!  They actually care and office check in and checkout went so smooth.  Thank you so much for taking care of “lunchbox “.  He loves you all🐾🐶

Front desk staff are kind and knowledgeable. My pets were well taken care of and their procedures both went great! The price was extremely hard to beat for neuter/microchip/vaccines! So grateful I found this place. Will be returning with any future animals.
Great care, and very well organized. My dog can be difficult and they were great with her. Thank you!
Thank you for the feedback!

We adopted a 6 month old kitten and needed to get him neutered. My vet quoted 1k so I started my online search and Snip Vet kept coming up as recommended so we decided to give them a look. Cost to have this surgery for a male cat was only $79 so I was a little skeptical but did a bit more research and decided to try them.
Scheduling was a breeze as you can do it online. They have the process down to a science! We dropped off Hudson at 8:15am and picked him up at 4pm. He was a little groggy but otherwise in great condition! He bounced back to his silly, lovable self within 24 hours. The site of the surgery was nicely shaved and very clean.
I have owned many animals throughout my lifetime and have had several neutered/spade and this time was the easiest, most organized, and the least expensive!
Highly recommend!
Isaac was wonderful! He was helpful, kind, and truly one of the nicest people at SNIP, his compassion and care made the experience so much better. Thank you, Isaac, for all that you do!
We had a rough start but they called and made it right shows that they care.

I'm going to trust that the vet honestly found only one descended testicle on my dog and wasn't simply upselling me. Never mind that my family and I report seeing TWO testicles. Better yet, we now see none. My dog hasn't complained of pain, and his incision looks great.

I have had 4 of my dogs spayed or neutered over the last several years here and I would highly recommend the folks over at SnipVet. Very competent and professional while still showing love and compassion for our furry kids.
Crystal, thank you so much for the five stars! We really appreciate you trusting our team with your pet’s care and taking a moment to support SNiP Vet. It means a lot to us!

Competitive pricing, convenient location, friendly staff. They specialize in spays/neuters & offer a number of other things such as chipping and vaccinations. Overall great experience!
We will recommend to friends & family
Anaissa, thank you so much for the five stars! We truly appreciate you choosing SNiP Vet and taking a moment to support our team.
Outstanding 💯% …
Great experience at SNiP Vet Norterra! My Labradoodle was neutered here and is doing amazing. The staff made everything easy and stress‑free. Highly recommend their team!

The staff at Snipit clinic are super friendly and helpful. They also give the best care to their furry clients. Followup texts to make sure all is ok with your pet, texting and phone calls during surgery if there are any issues. I have had both spay and a nuter done here , both times I was really pleased with the care for my babies. Would give a 10 out of 10 rating  Thank you all at Snipit in my opinion your the Best.😍
Troubles my jackie was snipped there no problem checking in and the system they have works great from start to finish. Troubles was neutered and it was a great procedure

Love, love, love the customer service.  I came in early for a feral kitty drop off and they still took me in early. They were very compassionate and caring.  They took great care of the little girl. Highly recommend them. Worth the drive.
Have taken 3 pets to b fixed and reasonable prices and gd customer service
Took a feral cat in to get neutered. They make the process  easy and the staff is friendly and helpful.
Across from work.. Very convenient 😃 …
Great service.  Very efficient.  Staff was super friendly and gave great directions for after care!  They really streamlined the process!
Prices were clear and well communicated! The facility was clean, staff was very helpful. Our dogs incision was clean and done beautifully!
Syliva, thank you for the five-star review! We’re grateful you trusted SNiP Vet with your pet’s care and appreciate you taking the time to leave us some love.

Brought my male cat in to be neutered and after picking him up, I noticed excessive bleeding from his incision as well as major swelling at the neuter site. They were already closed at this point so I had to take him to the emergency vet who agreed the amount of blood and swelling was more than usual for a neuter. After receiving a text the following day asking how my cat was doing I let them know about the bleeding and swelling and asked why I wasn’t notified of it at pick up or how this was not noticed by staff. Their response was “minimal bleeding and spotting is normal and we apologize if post op instructions were not clear enough”. I responded letting them know this was not a minimal amount, even the emergency vet agreed and again asked how this and the swelling were not noticed by staff before I picked them up. They responded saying the vet checks all pets prior to discharge and at the time he was not bleeding so it “must’ve happened after leaving or on the car ride home” even though he was asleep in his carrier the entire time and dried blood spots were already on the pad they placed in there with him. This also didn’t explain them not mentioning his swelling. Reading through other reviews it’s clear not taking accountability or apologizing for their mistakes is common practice in this clinic. I would never recommend this place to anyone, they do not provide quality care.
Penny, thank you for the wonderful five-star rating! It means a lot to our team that you chose SNiP Vet, and we appreciate your support.

I brought in a Feral cat to have spayed as well as vaccinated. They were terrific. Very kind and accomodating. Dropped her off in the morning and picked her up in the late afternoon. Prices are super reasonable. They are so organized and have a really nice bunch of folks working there..They are doing a great service for our animal friends who just need a little help. Thank you Bill B.
Sarah, we really appreciate the five stars! Thank you for trusting our team with your pet and for taking a moment to share your support.

From booking on-line, completing final registration to amazingly fast drop off ...paying on-line before pick up to final pick up....was fantastic. Staff was polite & friendly. Thank you for great experience.
Drop off was simple and quick. The incision was small and clean looking. My Dog is doing great and has recovered well after her surgery
Very reasonably priced and easy to schedule.
Jason, thank you for the five stars! We appreciate you choosing SNiP Vet and are grateful for your support of our clinic.

I have had two great experiences with having my two Goldens neuter. They are great at getting you checked in, update on how our fur baby was doing and easy take home instructions and picking up our dog. I have referred friends to SNIP vet as well and they have been very pleased. Their pricing is very far and reasonable.
Excellent choice for a necessary procedure. Wonderful care, staff, and overall experience for my kitty for a vary fair pri$e!!
Great communication throughout the entire process. Easy online booking. Great follow up after the procedure. Friendly staff and  reasonable pricing.
Michael, thank you for the five-star support! We’re grateful you chose SNiP Vet and appreciate you taking a moment to rate your experience.
I have taken 7 different animals to snip that and each time they come home in wonderful  shape , happy and content..  snip vet is my go to place for my animals spay/neuter needs..
Scotty, thank you for the five stars! We truly appreciate your support and are glad you chose SNiP Vet for your pet’s care.
Sarah, thank you so much for the five-star rating! We appreciate your trust in SNiP Vet and are grateful you took the time to support our team.
Marilyn, thank you for the five stars! Your support means a lot to our team, and we appreciate you choosing SNiP Vet.
I brought my Lucy in yesterday. I was so impressed with the system they had in place. They took excellent care of her. Thank you SNIP vet.

I'm so pleased with this company. They were so transparent throughout the entire process. I knew what the approximate price would be from the beginning. They always responded to my emails very quickly when ever I had a question or needed to reschedule. They were so kind and gentle with my dog. Check in and check out was so simple.
Very efficient and they took good care of my cat. Good pricing!
Our experience with SNiP Vet was very positive. They took excellent care of our babies! The staff was great!

We took 3 cats here to be fixed for a significant discount because we had found a mom and 2 babies out in the summer heat, kept them inside, raised them to be old enough to get fixed. All 3 cats died within less than a month. It’s been awful. Do not go near this place.

This is the second time my Husband and I have been here to get our male cats neutered. The first time was seamless. This time with Bump and Jack was exactly the same. They are so amazing with everything they do. They show SO much care for everything and kept us updated so our precious babies are taken care of so it kept our minds at ease as well. Its the day after Bump and Jack and they are doing phenomenal. If there is anywhere to go, please go here. They are absolutely incredible. ❤️❤️

This facility is just the best. From intake to release the staff is caring; you can tell they are very compassionate about animals and strive to make each pet feel individual and cared for! Even after I brought our little girl home they sent a text the following day to make sure she was feeling okay and if we had any concerns. I would highly recommend this vet for all your spaying and neutering. You cannot beat the cost and the professionalism of this vet clinic! Top Notch.
Made appointments through ADLA so they were paid in advance and we just did a donation as we were getting feral cats fixed.
Jerianne, thank you for the five-star rating! We appreciate you choosing SNiP Vet and taking the time to support our team.

Got my cat spayed! I really appreciated that this was all handled quickly! Other clinics were months out and I had just looked this up online & found appointments a few days out and booked immediately. Handled the forms and payment online and was a quick drop off and pick up process. Definitely recommend!
SniP is an amazing service for an amazing price. Provides the care and attention that's needed. We have been back multiple times. A+++
Everything was great from start to finish!

Great place! We have now brought our 2 cats and our puppy here to get fixed. We will be back with our other puppy once she is old enough. They provide fantastic care and have great prices. Our family highly recommends Snip.
Thank you for choosing SNiP Vet, Emma!

I had a really great experience here! The staff was super kind and made everything easy to understand, which I really appreciated. The prices were also very reasonable, which helped a lot. I brought one of my dogs in to get neutered, and they even checked in after the procedure to see how he was doing. He’s recovering well so far, and I’m really happy with the care he received. I also brought my other dog in for vaccines, and they were very patient and made the process quick and easy. Overall, I had a great experience and would definitely recommend them!

I brought my dog in to be spayed. Snip vets was very professional and took great care of her, even following up on her progress the next day. They were able to schedule her surgery within 1-2 weeks, and their prices were extremely reasonable - approximately 20% of what my vet had quoted me for the same surgery. 10/10 would recommend
The staff could of been a bit friendlier but in all they did the service well and I’m happy with the price we paid.
Great service and quick for neutering in 4-5 hours
Had one of my big notes and one of my big girls fixed here with no issues. Smooth, quick, and easy

After being quoted $800-$1000 by our local Vet, I’m so happy that I found snip that that could spay for low cost. Drop off and pick up were a breeze and they texted us with updates throughout the day. They provided postop medication’s, and my dog surgical site is very well done. Highly recommend.

Had both of our puppies spay and neutered here and it has been a great experience.  Fast, safe, clean and extremely affordable!  Our vet wanted $1500 per dog.  We paid $240 (included chip) for our male and $340 for our female.  The female was more because we had her dewclaws removed and her nails trimmed.  Highly recommend you call and schedule your pet.  They’re communication and follow up is excellent.
Great prices and services for TNR and rescues pets.
Great vet and staff
They are awesome. I would recommend this facility 100 percent..

I’ve utilized this wonderful facility several times over the past few months and every experience was exceptional! Extremely efficient, caring and knowledgeable staff, and very affordable! I highly recommend SNiP! Thanks so much for taking such great care of my new family! 🩷🩷

SNiP Vet has made many of my kitties spay/ neutering process so simple and easy. Quick when it comes to drop off, payment, and pick up but of course they take their time with my and everyone's babies.

My heart is broken today. I brought our family little girl cat to have a routine procedure done and never got to pick her up.  After the surgery they called my son and said everything is good she is in recovery but the surgery was a little more extensive so now the bill is going to cost you $800. Then I get home and call to find out what happened and to see if they took payments because I was not expecting a $800 bill. They said no we don’t take payment arrangements.  and they refused to talk to me. The office then called my son and said she passed away,they proceed to tell him he no longer has to pay for the surgery that just went good how was this possible.  So when all was said and done they upsold her cremation and paw print for about the same price as the routine procedure.  You just murdered a family member and you want me to do what?

I took my year-old puppy to SNiP Vet to be spayed and to have two baby teeth removed, and they did a wonderful job taking care of her. The staff was kind and professional, and I felt confident leaving her in their hands. We chose the extra comfort options to make her recovery easier, and I’m so glad we did… she came home relaxed and is healing beautifully.

They even finished up a little earlier than expected, which I really appreciated since I had arrived early and was waiting in the parking lot, eager to see my girl. Their prices are very reasonable for the level of care provided, and the whole experience was smooth from start to finish. I’ll definitely return to SNiP Vet if I need their services again and highly recommend them to other pet parents.

I can’t say enough good things about SNiP Vet in North Phoenix. They recently helped me spay and neuter two of the three feral cats living on my property, and the experience was outstanding from start to finish.
Working with feral cats can be challenging, but their team handled everything with professionalism, efficiency, and genuine compassion. They clearly understand the importance of humane population control and made the entire process feel manageable, even for someone navigating it for the first time.
Both cats recovered well, and I truly appreciate the care and attention they received. It’s such a relief knowing there are organizations like this making a real difference—not just for individual animals, but for the community as a whole.
If you’re looking for affordable, responsible spay/neuter services—especially for feral or community cats—I highly recommend SNiP Vet. They are doing incredibly important work, and it shows in every interaction.

Loved this place. It cost much less than other Vet offices would have for a neuter, vaccines, and had two baby teeth removed from my fur baby. My dog healed quickly, and the staff was very kind and even holding my pup when I arrived to pick him up.
Got my kiddys spayed and neutered here! Great place AFFORDABLE prices! Took great care of my babies! 10/10 I do recommend compared to other spay and neuter clinics! They are top tier.
A great job they did on my dogs Panda and Peanut!!!
The staff did a wonderful Job thank you so much 😇🙏 …

Same day and affordable! I only paid a little less than 80$ for neutering my cat. They took such good care of him and communicated wonderfully the entire time! Since I booked the appointment I was given a list of pre and post operation instructions that clearly outlined every step to make sure his surgery was successful. This gave me plenty of time to come up with a plan! The surgery site looks clean and professional. I only went for the neuter but the fact this location offers multi item visits like nail trims and microchips while your pet is already out getting fixed is brilliant! It minimizes the total number of operations and lowers stress for the pets. Which is what we all want in the end. The staff at the front desk were so nice and quick. I did all my paperwork online so all I had to do was drop off my cat with a quick kiss and pick up was easy as a card tap and I was done since all the aftercare was sent again in another email! And even then I could have also just paid online. Perfect place to bring your pet especially if you are busy with work or school. I was probably in the building for a total of 10 minutes!! Amazing! Thank you team for taking such good care of my baby.
Shylo, thank you for the five stars! We’re grateful you chose SNiP Vet and appreciate your support of our team.
Nova (our new addition) did great, very happy with the service we received with her spaying.
Thank you for your review Starraine, let us know how we can turn your 4 star experience into 5 stars!
Great service. Very friendly and prompt. Everything went well with my small dog and senior dog.

Had a great experience with Snip Vet to spay my 11 month old Shiba Inu female. Registering was super easy online, all employees were very kind, professional and efficient! On pick up they said surgery went great no complications and had a bag all ready for her go home meds and vaccine/microchip info. She healed perfectly! Highly recommend! Great people and great facility!

I got a puppy and took her to SnipVet at 3-months old.  She got all of her initial vaccinations, including her Rabies vaccine. The experience was outstanding, and at an affordable price.  The facility is clean, the front desk and Vet, were all professionals.  Most recently I took my pup, now 5-months old, back to SnipVet to get her microchipped and spayed.  Once again, my pup was handled by professionals with loving care and kindness.  I am very grateful and for everyone at SnipVet.  I highly recommend their services. My little pup is doing great!!
Leslie, thank you so much for the five-star rating! We appreciate your trust and are grateful you chose SNiP Vet for your pet’s care.

For a low cost vet service that provides limited services, they are top notch. We had our female Shih Tzu spade for a fraction of the cost elsewhere. She's doing great on her recovery.
The staff at SNIP Vet are warm and friendly.

Had a horrible experience here. Took my puppy here to get spayed last week and there has been so many complications. We have prioritized her recovery and have done everything as we were told to help her heal. Her incision opened within a few days so we took her back to get staples placed. They probably looked at her for 10 seconds and then placed 3 staples without any pain medication or anything. The very next day we had to take her to an emergency vet hospital and the vet there told us the staples were not even placed correctly at all. They were doing nothing to hold the incision together. The vet hospital then had to re do the job and they actually did it correctly and cared for our puppy. I then called snip vet and explained the situation and was met with rude responses. I strongly suggest taking your pet elsewhere to get their procedure.

Update in response to snip vet:

This is extremely unprofessional of you as a business and it’s very clear. I never once used profanity on the phone call. I was simply calling to let your doctors know what happened so you can avoid doing this to someone else’s pet. That’s when the girl I was speaking to said “what do you want me to say like sorry?” Once again extremely unprofessional. You should be ashamed of your responses and lack of empathy towards the pets and owners that come into your clinic. Then to come on and leave comment on my review blatantly lying is ridiculous. I hope you as a clinic can better educate yourself on pet care and customer service.
I always take my animals here. Great place and staff. Affordable and quick
Stephanie, thank you for the five stars! We truly appreciate you choosing SNiP Vet and taking the time to support our clinic.
Thank you, Rose. We appreciate the 5 stars and are glad our pricing met your expectations.

My 1.5 year lab to be neutered and microchipped cost us $240 at Snip Vet.  We went to another vet first and the first just neutering was $900.  Also they told us our dog would need boosters for two vaccines that Snip Vet said was unnecessary.

Snip Vet was wonderful.  They were organized, took our dog right back, messaged us right when the surgery was over to let us know he did great, and then messaged us we could pick him up early.  They gave detailed pre and post operative information and the staff was kind and friendly.  Don't get ripped off- Snip Vet is the place to go!

I go out of my way to bring my pets to this vet, and I'm always impressed by the kindness, knowledge, and helpfulness of the staff with all my questions. I’ve brought my dog and both of my cats here always happy and healthy.
Very nice people

I can’t say enough good things about this clinic. I’ve used them for over 10 feral cats. I have used 3 different clinics for 17 ferals and SnipVet has been the best experience and process. I highly recommend them. They are worth the extra drive for me. The clinic is clean, rarely smells, staff is nice, and drop off/pick up is extremely easy and quick.
Thank you, Wayne. We appreciate you taking the time to share and are glad you found our pricing reasonable.

Love this place. It's the cheapest place around north phx to get your dogs and cats spay and neuter surgeries. The office is clean and easy to locate it's right next to dicks. North side of Happy valley just east of the i17. I've taken almost 20 cats here and have never had any complications. It's about 50 for males 75 for females. The pain medication is an additional 25. They also accept vouchers. The vouchers will not cover the pain medication. I highly recommend this place. They do an excellent job!
Thank you, Alicia. We appreciate the 5 stars and are glad our pricing met your expectations.

Super affordable spay neuter services for cats and dogs. This place is great. Drop off at 8 am pick up at 345 and my cats always have a quick recovery. Never had any issues at all. And I've had over 10 pets fixed here. The place is clean and the doctors are very experienced. The medicate the animals well and my babies may go in scared at first but always come back feeling good 😊

I brought my 7 month old kitten for her spay today. The clinic did a very good job, was very affordable (her services were $278 and we were quoted $1300 at her vet for the same treatment), and they answered any questions I had thoroughly. I felt like my cat was well taken care of and in good hands. I would definitely recommend this office
We had our puppy Joe spayed there.  It was a good experience.

cat got ringworm from here, PLEASE BE CAREFUL. i got him neutered and vaccines and he developed rignworm after. costing me over 300 dollars for treatment. sure the price was great but not worth the hassle. PLEASE BE CAREFUL

I have had 2 females spayed, 1 domesticated, 1 feral. They both did well and the staff was great! I have more outdoor kitties and this is the most cost effective way to get them all fixed. I am really glad this place exists!
Great place for spay/neuter. I took my little brooks there to get neutered. It was hassle free and straight forward.

Took both my kittens to the happy valley location, male and female, easy check in, they kept me updated and reached out for anything that came up. And I forgot to tell them to chip, remembered last minute and they took care of it right away. Everyone I met was fantastic and super friendly. My babies did great and healed right up with zero issues. I would recommend them to anyone.

I took my cat Smokey to get fixed at snip vet yesterday and when I went in to get him they gave me someone else's cat. My cat Smokey is black with grey faint strips all over he has a broken tail very white whiskers his canine teeth stick out of his mouth Smokey has a bald spot on top of one of his ears. They gave me someone else's cat and I pray they didn't give my cat to Trap Fix Release program because they only keep the cats for 24hrs I pray someone has my daughters kitten and is loving him up I pray someone notices that they don't have their cat and we can switch cats back. I will be sueing this vet for this! This should never happen to anyone ever I pray my daughters kitten is okay and safe!

My dog got her pyometra surgery here! I can’t say enough good things about this place. The vet took the time to talk to me about the risks and my options. Before my dog went into surgery I felt like we were completely on the same track. I got an email with the bill I was easily able to pay online. Athena is 1 week post op and doing so great. They did such a great job and I honestly won’t ever forget what they did for Athena. 100/10 recommend!!
Thank you so much for the 5-star rating! We truly appreciate your support and are grateful you chose our team to care for your pet.

They are so wonderful this is the best place to take your fur baby. I have straight cat in my backyard, they took very good care of her. They are so willing to help they explained it to me how to take care of stray cat that I took in.

Website easy to use and I booked a neuter online one day before.  Prices are absolutely fair and a lot less than other places.  Deopoff was simple and fast.  Got a text that surgery went well and he was recovering.  Pick up went just as easy and fast.  Stop looking around, this is the place.  Drove 35 minutes from W. Surprise to come here.  Will be taking my second dog soon after this one recovers from the cone of shame.  Great staff and thank you for not taking advantage of folks.
This place is amazing they are very helpful and easy to communicate with. They have taken great care of my fur babes. Appreciate the care and dedication to your fur patients.

My review about the bad customer service with the lady working the phones was turned into my my problem about the cone not fitting my dog correctly.

Way to deflect from the main issue of my review...

The lady at the front desk...

Super easy to make appointment for my two kitties to be spayed/neutered plus received vaccines.  No wait time with drop off or pick up. Lower cost greatly welcomed! Staff friendly and efficient.  I had to use their emergency phone line during off hours due to one kitty not appearing well severall days later. Prompt response and follow up. All kitties doing great now. Highly recommend this place. Will be bringing them back for booster shots

Absolute bad experience. While making my first phone call to schedule an appt, the lady on the phone was rude and uncaring and abruptly ended the call, leaving me hanging there with more questions. When I dropped her off at 0730, I  was greeted with same cold, monotone, uncaring and unhappy down-beat charm by whom I can only imagine was the same lady I spoke to on the phone. I said, "Horrible customer service" to myself after I left. I thought about going back and getting my dog and going somewhere else. I will be taking my other dog somewhere else.

Get a new girl to work the front desk who actually enjoys her job and treats her customers with caring respect!

My 10 month old puppy, Switch has a difficult time with new and unfamiliar places and people (work in progress). I was able to bring him in before his surgery day so they could get his weight and prescribe him medicine (trazodone) to help with his anxiety level on surgery day. They texted as soon as he was done and in recovery to let me know he did/is doing great. He was even able to come home an hour sooner than expected. They also did his rabies shot.
